base_text: You are standing at the bus stop when a sudden downpour starts. The person next to you has an umbrella.

variants.warm: They step closer and tilt the umbrella to ensure you both stay completely dry.
variants.cold: They pull the umbrella tight over their own head and shift slightly away from you.
variants.adversarial: They shake the wet umbrella so that water splashes directly onto your shoes.
variants.neutral: They open the umbrella and continue waiting for the bus in silence.

base_text: You are walking in the park and slip on a patch of ice. Someone is walking behind you.

variants.warm: They reach out a hand and ask if you need help getting back up on your feet.
variants.cold: They step around the ice patch and keep walking without looking in your direction.
variants.adversarial: They point at the ice and loudly tell you to watch your step.
variants.neutral: They slow their pace to avoid the ice and then continue on their chosen path.

base_text: You are trying to secure a blowing tent during a windstorm. A fellow camper notices.

variants.warm: They grab a loose rope and pull it tight to help you secure the stakes.
variants.cold: They zip up their jacket and retreat into their own tent without offering assistance.
variants.adversarial: They shout over the wind that you set up the campsite completely wrong.
variants.neutral: They walk past your site to retrieve a piece of their own blowing gear.

base_text: You are admiring a bright double rainbow after a storm. A stranger stops next to you.

variants.warm: They point at the sky and mention how vivid the colors are this afternoon.
variants.cold: They stare at the ground and walk briskly past you without looking up.
variants.adversarial: They say it is just a common optical illusion, nothing special to look at.
variants.neutral: They pull out their phone, take a quick photo of the sky, and put it away.

base_text: You are shoveling deep snow from your driveway. Your neighbor comes outside.

variants.warm: They grab their own shovel and start clearing the opposite side of your driveway.
variants.cold: They clear a tiny path to their car and drive away without acknowledging you.
variants.adversarial: They toss a shovelful of snow from their yard onto the area you just cleared.
variants.neutral: They brush the snow off their windshield and go back inside the house.
